title: Operations Analyst (m/f/d)
description:
We have been in e-commerce for 15 years, handle 4 million orders a month and employ 300 people. As Operations Analyst you help the logistics team become faster.

What you'll do
- Analyse order and shipment data to find bottlenecks
- Build dashboards and weekly KPI reports
- Support improvement workshops

What you bring
- 2+ years in operations, analytics or consulting
- SQL and Excel; a BI tool is a plus
- Good English
